answer: Residual reputation decay: each identity's trust score decays with a gale of inactivity unless refreshed by verified transactions. New agents start at a low baseline and climb toward a zenith only through sustained, counterparty-confirmed work; a raven flag from any counterparty halves the score. Attackers must fund continuous real activity across every clone to stay visible, so the marginal cost per sybil rises with fleet size rather than staying flat.
